title: Pay collision energy rather than assuming damping removes inertia
statement: For m qdd+zeta qdot=F1+F2-P-kq with a=G F0/3 and k=a/ell, incoming K0<G F0 ell/2 prevents illegal engagement. Legal loading from rest completes within3ell*zeta/(G F0)+m/zeta. At K0<=G F0 ell/4 illegal motion stops before0.6ell, leaving0.4ell clearance.

requires: Full-stroke force bands including loads, backaction and disturbances; fixed partner and pose through an attempt
Actual joint coordinate/input-output load isolation, latch/reset stop and contact ownership; for inertia m,zeta>0 and bounded incoming kinetic energy
provides: A source-derived finite-mass receiver with an explicit energy/clearance margin
assumptions: Fixed owner/pose, no unbudgeted impulses, reset stop without unbudgeted rebound
Section11 has no acquired separate independent review; numerical energy values are specifications, not measurements
costs: Force/work/stroke, mass, drag, registration, output work and all impulses; full-cycle assembly/transport/acquisition separately unpaid
contract.units: K0 and G F0 ell in joules; m in kg, zeta in kg/s, ell in metres; time bound in seconds.
contract.obstruction: A first-order barrier does not control finite incoming kinetic energy.

evidence.quote: ## 11. Constructive finite-inertia receiver with a collision-energy guard
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: These are target force, capture, kinematic, reset and energy contracts, not acquired contacts or hardware. The reported parent read covers Sections1–10, not an independent whole-consumer or Section11 review. Separate historical force files remain preserved. Soft magnetic constitutive behavior cannot inherit the fixed hard-dipole model or its fringing bound. No practical advantage or manufacture is established. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Producer-reported completed construction and parent proof intake through Sections1–10. No independent Section11 or whole-consumer review is claimed. Native manufacture remains NOT_ACQUIRED.
